messages:
Anna K: opened a quick PR for the Dedicated provisioning migration guide — trying to consolidate autoscale wording and add an SDK + YAML example. PR: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/842
Mike T: skimmed — main ask: clarify cooldown vs. preemption behavior in the autoscale section. current sentence is ambiguous.
Sasha R: agree. can we add a tiny concrete YAML example showing scalePolicy + cooldown? e.g.:
```yaml
scalePolicy:
  mode: target_utilization
  target_utilization: 0.6
  cooldown_sec: 120
  preemption_behavior: best_effort
```
DevRel Sam: +1 for a short SDK snippet next to it. propose a python example that shows creating a Dedicated reservation and attaching the scale policy:
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()
res = client.create_reservation(name="staging-res", gpus=4)
res.set_scale_policy(target_utilization=0.6, cooldown_sec=120)
```
Leo P: tiny nit — the SDK call above should be .update_scale_policy rather than .set_ for our current client surface. also we should show an example using tenant labels for isolation.
Marie O: important: the SLA section currently says "best effort" which legal flagged as vague. suggest: "SLA: 99.95%% uptime for reserved capacity; preemption allowed only under urgent maintenance with 24hr notice" — need docs-consensus before we publish.
ops-oncall: fyi from ops: preemption_behavior: best_effort means jobs can be evicted without client retry; we should document fallback behavior: automatic routing to compatible model variant if reservation is unavailable. also add a note about quota enforcement window (15m) — that bit trips customers up.
docs-bot: link-checker failed on the provisioning anchor: https://git.redwood/docs/blob/main/dedicated.md#tenant-labels — 404.
Anna K: thanks — I'll update the PR with: 1) Sasha's YAML, 2) corrected SDK call (Leo), 3) explicit SLA wording (Marie) and 4) ops note about fallback routing and quota window.
Mike T: can you also add a one-line migration note: "If you used the legacy scale_schema v1, rename `cooldown` -> `cooldown_sec` and remove `batch_target`" — pen that in the compatibility section.
Anna K: yep will add that. tagging @DevRel Sam for a short sample app that demonstrates tenant-labels + isolation fallback (devrel ticket tg-331).
DevRel Sam: I'll sketch the sample app tomorrow and paste code in the PR.
Leo P: after those edits, we should squash into a single commit and request a final review from legal for the SLA phrasing.
Marie O: thanks — once legal signs off I'll approve copy for public docs.
Anna K: plan: push edits by EOD, request reviewers: @Mike T, @Leo P, @Marie O. any objections?
Mike T: none. :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: +1 — will schedule a quick internal runbook update to match the wording change.
Anna K: awesome — closing checklist: add YAML, replace SDK call, add fallback/quotas note, fix link, add migration snippet, request legal review. I'll ping here when PR is green. :party:
